sn19.16:1.1: Idhāham āvuso Gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasam asīsakaṃ kavandhaṃ vehāsam gacchantaṃ ||
sn19.16:1.2: tassa ure akkhīni ceva honti mukhañ ca || || 2
sn19.16:1.3: Tam enaṃ gijjhāpi dhaṅkā pi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti vibhajenti ||
sn19.16:1.5: Eso bhikkhave satto imasmiññeva Rājagahe Hāriko nāma coraghātako ahosi || ||
